description: Puts the forge and vi-natural CLIs on PATH at session start, and writes each skill's own stub for the tools this machine has saved configuration for, which the next session reads. A gate refuses only kernel input and teaches the rest: the call goes ahead and the next step and its reason arrive beside it. Before a call: refuses the shell commands whose damage cannot be undone, and teaches a lint run with --fix, a sleep in a wait and a log read typed again; teaches once beside a memory or skill write, including through the shell where the content cannot be read, and beside a write to a file no open session can pick up until it restarts. After a call: hands every code file that changed — whichever route wrote it — to the linter the project itself configured, its own copy where it has one and the vendored one where it does not, and teaches what it found; teaches once when a checker is about to hard-code the cases it already knows. This plugin owns when and where a rule fires; the project owns what the rule says. It also teaches the correction a CLAUDE.md write owes where it leaves a claim about this repository the repository does not bear out. Where a project ships `ready` it teaches the cheaper proof beside that project's own gate, naming the suites of the files changed and the hand-over, since there the landing gates every change. Before a write to an issue it lists that issue's comments itself: an empty list passes silently, and comments the session has not been shown are handed to the write as it goes ahead, since the read that looks complete returns none of them. Before a dispatch to one of this plugin's roles it teaches the brief to send where the message is not one the brief verb printed. Before a raw call on the tracker's own tools that one of this CLI's verbs wraps, a create among them, it refuses the call and names the verb, whose own door holds the pre-checks of what the tracker refuses. In a judge session it refuses a write past the judge's own verdicts. Before a question to the owner, in a project that opted in, it answers one the session declared reversible from the owner's own earlier answers, and after one the owner answered it keeps that answer as precedent. At the end of a turn, and at the end of a subagent's, it holds the stop while an issue stands silent under this session's lease or a process the turn started still stands, and teaches the rest it finds, each once with the command that clears it.

hooks.command: node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"/hooks/gate.mjs pre bash-guard landing-gate learning-gate restart-owed plan-scope issue-read-first judge-writes
